hypothesis: Baseline-eligible selection, sample-scaled shrinkage and causal monthly refitting may improve stability; improvement is not assumed
data: Reuse the exact verified v1 adjusted-close snapshots; no new acquisition
known_final_period: 2023-2025 was inspected; exclude it from this implementation and research selection
ridge_alpha_definition: training_sample_count * lambda, recomputed at every fit
training_window_unit: latest eligible training target observations, identical for all lookbacks
refit_contract: Validation candidates start at training cutoff; monthly refits use labels observed by origin only. After selection monthly test starts with a refit through validation, then refits when the observed origin enters a new calendar month. Frozen candidates never refit
selection: Inner chronological validation RMSE, tie tolerance 1e-12; prefer zero, training_mean, then Ridge in recorded order. Outer development folds compare the four policies; policy ties within 1e-12 prefer recorded policy order

uncertainty.interpretation: exploratory marginal intervals; no multiplicity correction or significance claim after policy selection

confirmation.rule: Freeze the selected method before collecting prospective predictions; only labels observed after recorded predictions can confirm it

stop_rule: Report every policy and negative result; do not expand this grid based on results. If no robust improvement emerges, retain the baseline and reassess the return-prediction task
